issues.text: Incomplete for this lesson's own Try it: step 1 references Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL, yet step 2 uses `DbContext`, declared in Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore, and the [Index] attribute is in Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Abstractions: assemblies of packages it depends on, not its own. issues.fix: Replace with: "a `PackageReference` line in a project file makes its assemblies, and those of the packages it depends on, available to that project." No claim needed (definition).
